newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Abecafe coffee exports 51 pct of Sept total.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Abecafe coffee exports 51 pct of Sept total.

text.p: Members of Brazilian Coffee Exporters Association (Abecafe) accounted for 51 percent or 577,606 60-kg bags of the 1.14 million bags shipped from Brazil in September, Abecafe's secretary-general said.

"This result goes to confirm the growing importance of Abecafe members in Brazilian exports. Abecafe accumulated shipments between January and September now reach 43 percent of the total," Jose Dauster Sette said in a statement.

Brazilian Coffee Exporters' Federation (Febec) is the traditional exporters' group in Brazil but last year a group of exporters formed Abecafe, principally because they opposed a private sector plan dividing out coffee exports internally.
The association now has 40 member firms.

The subject of exporter representation has come under the spotlight recently following the creation of a new council which unites the private and public sectors and which will determine coffee policy in the future.
Of the six places on the council set aside for public sector officials, only one has been designated for exporters, with Febec named as the official body.
Abecafe has already stated however it does not accept representation by Febec and it wants a neutral representative who does not favor either of the two groups.
A meeting earlier this week between the presidents of the two entities did not see any conciliation between the two bodies, said Abecafe president Jorge Esteve.
